column4: The steady roar of an old gas boiler burning in a small concrete basement boiler room: a deep low rumble of the flame, a faint metallic rattle of the casing, water ticking and gurgling in old iron pipes, constant and even with no beginning or end. Indoors, close, small hard room, 1980s Eastern Europe.

The constant low electric hum of an old 1970s refrigerator compressor running in a quiet small staff room, a soft steady drone with a very faint rattle, even and continuous with no beginning or end. Indoors, a few metres away, quiet room.

An old 1970s refrigerator door being pulled open: the rubber seal unsticking with a soft suck, glass bottles clinking together on the door shelf, the hum of the compressor louder for a moment. Close, indoors, small room.
An old 1970s refrigerator door swung shut: a dull padded thump of the rubber seal and bottles rattling on the door shelf. Close, indoors, small room.

Pouring old filter coffee from a glass jug into a thick ceramic mug: the jug lifted off a hot plate with a scrape, a hiss of the last drops on the plate, coffee glugging and gurgling into the mug, the jug set back down. Close, indoors, small room.

A tall thin sheet-metal staff locker door being opened: the latch handle lifted with a clack, the dented metal door swinging open with a hollow tinny wobble and a hinge squeak. Close, indoors, small room with hard walls.
A tall thin sheet-metal staff locker door slammed shut: a loud hollow metallic clang, the latch snapping into place, the thin metal ringing briefly. Close, indoors, small room with hard walls.
